title: Independent Finding Audit — All 13 Findings Reclassified
methodology: Each finding traced from original evidence → issue → PR → commit → current upstream state. Evidence quality reclassified (T1-T5). Status independently determined.

findings.upstream_verdict: Still correct — compass source unchanged, dist v0.3.0 hash 7ed6cc82 verified
findings.notes: Source-gated. Only actionable when system-compass fork access exists.

findings.title: F/f genuinely unbound in all releases
findings.evidence: Zero grep matches for F/f bindings across all 4 tarballs (E-005)

findings.title: KeyboardHelp byte-identical, no F entry
findings.notes: Source-gated. Exact line to add identified.

findings.title: Fit math constants invariant
findings.evidence: 9 constants extracted, invariant across releases (E-007, E-011)
findings.notes: Source-gated. Supports decision D-005 (F-key = keyboard only, no new camera system).

findings.title: #57 one-shot fit latch → keyed refit
findings.evidence: Release notes (Class A) + bundle comparison v0.2.0 vs v0.3.0 (E-008)
findings.upstream_verdict: Confirmed by authoritative source (KageBinary release notes)
findings.notes: Source-gated. Key architectural constraint: F-key must NOT add auto-frame or drill reframe.

findings.title: Delayed-data blank persists on v0.3.0
findings.evidence: 3 independent reproductions (v0.2.0×1, v0.3.0×2) — 0 cards visible on slow data (E-009, E-022)
findings.upstream_verdict: Still present. #57 refit does not fix this — different root cause (rollup timing).
findings.notes: Source-gated. Decision D-006 correctly separates this from F-key. Severity P1 — user sees nothing.

findings.title: Region rollup aggregate formation is timing-dependent
findings.evidence: Fast: 9 cards + 1 aggregate. Delayed: 15 cards, no aggregate. Same map_rev (E-012)
findings.notes: P2 severity. Medium confidence only. Could be load-order, not timing.
